metadata.title: Worldsheet skeins and block decomposition of quivers
metadata.abstract: Following the knot-quiver correspondence, we investigate quiver counterparts of the HOMFLYPT skein relations by interpreting link invariants in terms of holomorphic worldsheets and their multicover contributions. Extending this framework to more general worldsheet geometries, we conjecture that, up to quiver equivalence, the adjacency matrix of the quiver associated with any link in a skein triple admits a block decomposition whose diagonal blocks are quiver adjacency matrices associated with the other two links. We verify this conjecture in numerous examples.
metadata.comment: 46 pages, 5 figures; a Mathematica file is attached as an ancillary file

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 沿结–箭图对应，用全纯worldsheet及其多重覆盖贡献解释HOMFLYPT skein关系对应的箭图结构。
techniques: 箭图等价与邻接矩阵分块
analysis.breakthrough: 猜想在箭图等价后，skein三元组中任一链环的邻接矩阵可分块，两个对角块对应其余两条链环，并验证许多例子。
analysis.limitations: 一般结论仍是猜想，示例验证与伴随计算不能替代普遍证明。箭图等价的范围及非对角块信息需对照正文。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第33页脚注8与第36页声明明确GPT-5.6 Sol生成§6.9及附录B中的箭图操作简化序列，作者用Mathematica核对，另用于文献与小幅记号改善。记具体计算搜索、文献及记号编辑，未将总体worldsheet方法或分块猜想归于模型。声明说正文由作者撰写。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.07455v1 · PDF第33页脚注8、第36页 AI statement
